name: Verify email address
description: Confirms an address with a code and no link at all, for flows that must survive link rewriting by a security gateway or complete on another device.

origin.note: Design: single figure — the code is the whole message, sized as such, with no link to compete with or to be rewritten.

subject: {{ verification_code }} is your {{ product.name }} code
preheader: Type it into the window you already have open. Good for {{ expires_in }}.

body.description: Opening paragraph. Say where the code goes, since there is no link to carry them there.
body.default: Type this into the window where you started signing up. It works once, and only there.

verification_code.description: The code, set at 46px as the entire point of the message.

expires_in.description: How long the code stays valid.

wrong_window_note.description: What to do if they no longer have the window open. Worth stating: a code-only flow has no way to recover otherwise.
wrong_window_note.default: Closed the window? Start again and we'll send a new code.

security_note.description: Closing reassurance. Codes are phished more often than links, so this line does real work.
security_note.default: We will never ask you for this code by phone, chat or email. If you didn't request it, ignore this message.
